chapters.title: Between the Islands
chapters.body: Throughout Merrow Sound, no spoken word can travel from one island to another by any means. This permanent law admits no exceptions, regardless of distance, weather, equipment or magic.

chapters.title: Morning Roster
chapters.body: At 10:00 on 14 June, Aven Rill used the call sign Kite. The crew register confirms that nobody else used Kite at that time.

chapters.title: The Signal Hut
chapters.body: At 10:00 on 14 June, Kite was inside the West Jetty signal hut, a fixed building on land. The observer entered the call sign, rather than the person's name, in the log.

chapters.title: A Saffron Packet
chapters.body: At noon on 14 June, Edda Voss placed a packet of saffron under the parcel desk's blue tray. She then took an empty basket back to the market.

chapters.title: A Shape Offshore
chapters.body: At supper on 14 June, Brin Tal believed the eastern reef was a whale. He was mistaken: the narrator identifies the shape as an ordinary reef. His companions had not yet corrected him.

chapters.title: The Sealed Note
chapters.body: A sealed note naming tomorrow's landing place was left in Aven Rill's locker at 16:00 on 14 June. The locker entry records delivery but says nothing about Aven opening or reading the note.

chapters.title: East Pier
chapters.body: The mooring sheet records that one ferry was tied up at East Pier at 18:00 on 14 June. It gives neither the vessel's name nor a hull number.

chapters.title: The Two Ferries
chapters.body: Larkspur and Thistledown were the only ferries serving Merrow Sound that week. Each called at East Pier on a different evening. The fleet note does not give the dates of those calls.
